messages:
rui: FYI from the northstar-int6 onboarding sweep: structured funcall pass dropped 99.0% -> 87.4 on mixed-language prompts (>700 token kvcache). looks language-switch related.

may: can you share a failing sample?

rui: pasted trimmed emission. note weird RTL mark injected inside key name and an extra trailing comma in arrays sometimes — strict parsers choke. only on streams where we hit a boundary mid-word.

```
{"tool":"tag","args":{"items":[{"id":201,"label":"urgent"}, {"id":202,"label":"followup"},]}}
\n// observed raw (control shown as escape):
{"tool":"tag","args":{"items\u200f":[{"id":201,"label":"urgent"}]}}
```

hannah: U+200F (RIGHT-TO-LEFT MARK) showing up in key name. odd. other quant/int variants not reproducing?

rui: only on northstar-int6-int6q (weird name i know) in PTQ-lite runs. raven-lite and zephyr2-int4 fine.

tariq: did tokenizer mapping change between northstar v1->v2? mixlang tokenizers often map RTL marks differently.

may: i pulled token hex around emission: "... 0x3a 0xee 0x80 0x8f 0x2c ..." where reference decodes to ':' + space + ',' but this build decodes 0xEE80 0x8F -> U+200F before the array bracket.

hannah: could be a decode-table alignment bug in int6 quant compile or a kernel fallback using an older decoder table. also streaming chunk boundary + retry can splice partial bytes and create that sequence.

rui: reproducibility: high when we enable retry-on-early-eos and streaming buffer size = 512. single-shot short prompts rarely fail.

may: quick mitigation: enabled a canary-only sanitizer that strips RTL marks and normalizes trailing commas. pass rate recovers to 96.3 for the canary set.

tariq: we should not ship sanitizer globally — masks root cause. propose immediate actions:
- block northstar-int6-ptq sharded profile on Dedicated until fixed
- add schema-delta alert for any quant variant > 3% drop on golden sweep
- scheduled canary replays with and without sharding + retry matrix
- add unit test in tokenizer/roundtrip that injects U+200F and boundary splices for quant builds
- add short idempotency key on funcall events to dedupe duplicates during retry windows

hannah: i'll owner root-cause triage (check compile LUTs, codegen flags, and kernel fallbacks). ETA EOD tomorrow.

ops-bot: Canary job queued: cci-92222. targets: northstar-int6-ptq (sharded & non-sharded) and northstar-ptq-mirror. link: https://ci.redwood/cci/92222.

may: i'll attach token dumps, seeds, and failing traces to RWI-2410. gist: https://gist.redwood/g/92222-northstar-repro

rui: infra note: duplicates observed in logs — two identical tool events within 60ms when retry occurred before downstream ack. router dedupe needed.

tariq: i'll prototype router dedupe with 300ms window and optional per-route opt-in. will measure perf impact (expected <0.5ms).

hannah: also check whether the int6 codegen uses different signedness for LUT indexing; we've seen signed/unsigned shifts cause odd control bytes in earlier bring-ups.

may: i'll add a CI gate that diffs compiled decoder LUT blobs against reference host LUT during quant compile. prevents regressions.

rui: agreed. immediate priorities: block Dedicated profile, run canary, triage LUT/codegen. will update thread with canary results. thanks team. :thumbsup:
